channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Ferry Landing
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Ferry Landing (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The ferry landing's 'under construction' entry is now…
item.description: The ferry landing's 'under construction' entry is now dated April 28, 2026, from the transportation authority's post saying earlier phases of construction are complete, not from the day we read the Port's page. The status is unchanged. Source: SFCTA, '$9.8 Million in Sales Tax Funds Approved to Support Downtown Revitalization, Caltrain Station ADA Improvements, and Mission Bay Ferry Landing', Apr 28, 2026 (https://www.sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The Port's schedule lists the marine demolition phase as…
item.description: The Port's schedule lists the marine demolition phase as complete, but that is one phase, not the ferry landing. The record still shows the landing as under construction, and its timeline no longer marks the landing complete. One open question notes that the Port and SFCTA word the state of the current phase differently. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Bay Ferry Landing (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/mission-bay-ferry-landing), Project Schedule: "2025 Phase 2a Marine Demolition and Mattress (complete)"; "2026/2027 Phase 2b Mission Bay Ferry Landing and Agua Vista Park (in progress)". SFCTA, April 28, 2026: "the Port of San Francisco has completed earlier phases of construction".
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Bay Ferry Landing (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/mission-bay-ferry-landing), Project Schedule: "2025 Phase 2a Marine Demolition and Mattress (complete)"; "2026/2027 Phase 2b Mission Bay Ferry Landing and Agua Vista Park (in progress)". SFCTA, April 28, 2026: "the Port of San Francisco has completed earlier phases of construction"

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post calls it "a new $77.1 million…
item.description: SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post calls it "a new $77.1 million ferry landing" and records a $4.5 million Prop L allocation; SFCTA's June 2024 program shows a total project cost of $82,450,000. The two totals are not reconciled. The Port's undated page lists Phase 2b as "in progress" and Phase 2a marine demolition as complete (2025); completion of the landing is expected by the end of 2027. Source: https://www.sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada; https://www.sfcta.org/sites/default/files/2024-06/EP%2012%20Mission%20Bay%20Ferry%20Landing%20Prop%20L%202023%205YPP%20Approved%206.25.24.pdf; https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/mission-bay-ferry-landing; https://www.sfport.com/commission.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The Mission Bay Ferry Landing page no longer says the…
item.description: The Mission Bay Ferry Landing page no longer says the redevelopment-area boundary contains the landing. The two landing shapes drawn from the City's 2018 plan lie just outside DataSF's Mission Bay South boundary, a few metres from it at the nearest corner. Source: DataSF Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas (m288-24sn), 'Mission Bay - South'; Port of San Francisco, Mission Bay Ferry Landing (sfport.com/projects-programs/mission-bay-ferry-landing).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The ferry landing now sits at its designed position, with…
item.description: The ferry landing now sits at its designed position, with the separate water taxi landing the City reviews with it as one project. Both follow the City's 2018 plan, not as-built drawings, and nothing was built there in the August 2025 imagery. The outline is still approximate. Source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV (2018).
item.source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV (2018)

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: This page said no source places the ferry landing at the…
item.description: This page said no source places the ferry landing at the former Pier 64. The City's 2018 environmental review does: it says the project area is at Pier 64, called "Pier 64½" in the Port's Waterfront Land Use Plan documents. Source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV (2018).
item.source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV (2018)

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The City's environmental review names two Assessor lots…
item.description: The City's environmental review names two Assessor lots for the ferry landing project, 9900064 and 9900064H. This record had said no lot exists. The landings drawn on the map are the 2018 design and mostly lie outside those lots' outlines, so the map is unchanged. Source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV, cover page; DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the rows for Assessor lots 9900064 and 9900064H, queried 2026-10-10.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The April 2026 transportation sales-tax funding for the…
item.description: The April 2026 transportation sales-tax funding for the ferry landing was shown as $9.8 million. That figure covers three projects; SFCTA's own post gives the ferry landing $4.5 million, toward a $77.1 million project. Source: https://www.sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada.

item.title: Added · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: New nearby-project record for the WETA/Port Mission Bay Ferry…

item.title: Under construction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: SFCTA's post of April 28, 2026 says… (Apr 28, 2026)
item.description: SFCTA's post of April 28, 2026 says "Over the past several years, the Port of San Francisco has completed earlier phases of construction, including the removal of former Pier 64 and other underwater preparatory work." So construction was under way by that date. The Port's project schedule (undated; read Oct 17, 2026) lists "2026/2027 Phase 2b Mission Bay Ferry Landing and Agua Vista Park (in progress)" after three phases marked "(complete)". The date is the date of SFCTA's post, which shows the work under way; it is not the date construction or Phase 2b began. (Apr 28, 2026). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28; Port of San Francisco.
item.source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28; Port of San Francisco

item.title: Expected · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: Completion of the ferry landing is expected by the… (~2027)
item.description: Completion of the ferry landing is expected by the end of 2027. (~2027). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: SFCTA Board approves $4.5M in Prop L sales-tax… (Apr 2026)
item.description: SFCTA Board approves $4.5M in Prop L sales-tax funds toward what SFCTA calls "a new $77.1 million ferry landing" (its share of $9.8M approved for three projects; approved April 14, final approval April 28, 2026). This is a funding allocation, not a construction cost; SFCTA's June 2024 five-year program gives a different total project cost of $82,450,000 (see open questions). (Apr 2026). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04-28.
